metadata.scenario: An event planner calls to obtain a quote for providing on-site physical therapy services during a sports event. Category: Quote Request. Outcome: quote_provided.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is George Williams. I hope you're doing well. Hi George! I'm doing well, thank you. How can I help you today? I’m actually reaching out because I’m planning a local sports event and need a quote for on-site physical therapy services. Of course! We’d be happy to provide that. Can you tell me more about the event? Sure! It’s a charity sports event for heart health awareness. We expect a few hundred attendees. That sounds great! How many physical therapists do you need on-site, and for how long? I think two therapists would be ideal, and we’d need them for about four hours during the event. Alright, we can arrange that. Our physical therapy services are priced at $110 to $140 per session. So, for two therapists over four hours, what would that come to in total? Based on a four-hour commitment with two therapists, it would range from $880 to $1,120. That’s within our budget. What’s included in that price? That price includes on-site assessments, mobility training, and injury prevention exercises. Perfect! What’s the next step if I’d like to proceed with booking? I can prepare a formal proposal for you, requiring a deposit to secure the therapists. Sounds good. How much is the deposit? The deposit is usually 50% of the total cost. Okay, I can work with that. Can you also send over any credentials or details about the therapists? Absolutely! I’ll include their credentials and specialties in the proposal. Great! Do you have a timeline for when you can send that over? I can have it ready for you by the end of the day. That works perfectly, thank you. You're welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with? No, that should be it for now. I appreciate your help! My pleasure, George. I’ll follow up with that proposal soon! Looking forward to it. Bye! Bye!
